routes.label: Jaffa Road (red line corridor)
routes.note: Jaffa Road is tagged highway=pedestrian in OSM over this stretch because it carries the light rail and pedestrians only. The corridor is the real red line; the track, the stations and the platforms are authored.

routes.label: Hativat Yerushalayim
routes.note: Trunk road along the west wall of the Old City; the flattest corridor in range.

routes.label: HaTsanhanim
routes.note: Trunk road past the north wall; a real Egged trunk corridor.

routes.label: Sultan Suleiman
routes.note: The street outside Damascus Gate; in the real city the East Jerusalem bus terminals sit on it, so its bus share is the highest of the set.

routes.label: Maale HaShalom
routes.note: Tertiary approach climbing north-west from the Dung Gate side.

routes.label: Ma'alot Ir David and HaOfel
routes.note: Two ways sharing an endpoint; the main eastern spine below the Mount.
